search.title: Search Stations
search.description: Leave fields blank if you don't want to filter by them.

select_stations.title: Search Results
select_stations.description: Select the stations you want to add to Home Assistant.

init.title: Configure Station Updates
init.description: All stations share a single download; the shortest interval among your stations is used (minimum 15 minutes).

find_closest_stations.name: Find closest/cheapest stations
find_closest_stations.description: Returns the closest and cheapest gas stations within a given radius.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Number of stations to return per list.

radius.name: Search radius (km)
radius.description: Maximum distance to search for stations.

gas_type.name: Gas type
gas_type.description: Which fuel type to search for to find the cheapest price.

exclude_brands.name: Exclude brands
exclude_brands.description: Brands to leave out (e.g. Costco if you are not a member).

find_stations_ahead.name: Find stations ahead
find_stations_ahead.description: While driving, returns stations in front of you using your GPS position and heading.

heading.name: Heading
heading.description: Direction of travel in degrees (0 = north, 90 = east), the companion app's "course" attribute. Optional; ignored when speed says you are stopped.

max_offset.name: Max side offset (km)
max_offset.description: How far to the side of your direction a station may be. Grows by 15% of the distance ahead to follow curves.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Number of stations to return per list.

gas_type.name: Gas type
gas_type.description: Which fuel type to search for.

exclude_brands.name: Exclude brands
exclude_brands.description: Brands to leave out (e.g. Costco if you are not a member).

fill_liters.name: Litres to fill
fill_liters.description: Used to weigh the detour against the price for the best value list.

consumption.name: Fuel consumption (L/100 km)
consumption.description: Used to estimate what the detour costs.

speed.name: Speed (m/s)
speed.description: The companion app's "speed" attribute. Below 2 m/s (~7 km/h) the heading is ignored.

from_latitude.name: Previous latitude
from_latitude.description: Where you were a moment ago. Used to work out the direction when no usable heading is given.

from_longitude.name: Previous longitude
from_longitude.description: Where you were a moment ago.

fallback_radius.name: Fallback radius (km)
fallback_radius.description: Radius searched around you when no direction can be determined.
